units.source_text: 女人削完了土豆，把它切成小方块，和连同叶子一齐切好的萝卜一起，倒进了灶上的锅子里。

en.t: The woman finished peeling the potatoes, cut them into small cubes, and put them into the pot on the stove together with the radishes she had cut up, leaves and all.
The pot was a large iron cauldron.

units.source_text: 她小心翼翼地从塑料袋里拿出火柴，用完后，又用塑料袋包好，再扎上橡皮筋。

en.t: She carefully took the matches out of a plastic bag, and after using them, wrapped them back up in the bag and fastened it again with a rubber band.

units.source_text: 淘好的米，晾在筛子上，从上面浇水下去。

en.t: The washed rice was set out on a sieve, and water was poured over it from above.
She was probably trying to rinse away the sand.

units.source_text: 锅里煮的东西发出咕嘟咕嘟的声音，屋子里飘散着带有苦味的萝卜香气。

en.t: Whatever was cooking in the pot made a bubbling sound, and the room was filled with the slightly bitter smell of radish.
